name: Ridgeback Plumbing & Gas
tagline: Plumbing and gas fitting across Newcastle and Lake Macquarie
description: Local plumber and gasfitter for homes and small businesses: blocked drains, hot water, gas appliances, leaks and bathroom plumbing.
hours_note: Emergency call-outs 24/7, including weekends and public holidays.

facts.emergency: 24/7 emergency call-outs for burst pipes, gas leaks and blocked sewers.

services.name: Blocked drains
services.summary: Kitchen sinks, toilets, stormwater and sewer lines cleared with a drain camera and jetter.

services.name: Hot water
services.summary: Repairs and replacements for electric, gas, heat pump and solar hot water systems.

services.name: Gas fitting
services.summary: Cooktops, heaters and BBQ points installed and serviced, plus gas leak detection.

services.name: Leaks
services.summary: Leaking taps, pipes and toilets found and fixed, including hidden leaks in walls and slabs.

services.name: Bathroom and kitchen plumbing
services.summary: Rough-in and fit-off for renovations, working with your builder or tiler.

services.name: Backflow testing
services.summary: Annual backflow device testing and certification for businesses.

process.title: Call or send photos
process.text: Tell us what is happening. Photos on WhatsApp help us bring the right parts.

process.title: Quote before we start
process.text: We look at the job and give you a fixed quote before any work begins.

process.title: Fixed and cleaned up
process.text: We finish the job, clean up, and explain what we did.

facts.quotes: Free quotes for planned work. A call-out fee applies to emergency jobs.
facts.payment: Card, bank transfer or cash. Payment on completion.
